sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at the station, ready to travel to York.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I get my ticket out and ask a worker.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, is this the ten forty train to York?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, it's the right platform, and it's on time.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I've got a reserved seat, but which carriage?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Let me check your ticket for you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It says coach C, seat twenty-four, by the window.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's carriage C, and your seat's on the left.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, does reserved mean I can use that seat?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, it's yours for this train, so keep your ticket.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before the train comes, I ask about my bag.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I put my big bag on the luggage rack?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, there's a large rack near the carriage door.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I won't need to lift it above my head.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, and keep the way to the door clear.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I keep my small bag with me at my seat?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, under the seat in front of you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, my ticket and phone will go there.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You'll need your ticket later.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: That arrow points towards the front.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's the usual sign, but today's train is different.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The worker shows me where to wait instead.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Carriage C's at the back today, not the front, so wait by me.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, is my carriage at the front or the back?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: At the back, by this sign.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: At the back, got it, and do I get on here?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, wait here, then check the letter beside the door.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll get on at carriage C and find seat twenty-four.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Exactly, and let people get off before you get on.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll use the luggage rack and keep my ticket handy.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You're welcome, have a good trip to York.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I know where to wait and find my seat.
